get.summary: GetWebhookDelivery retrieves a specific webhook event delivery log.
get.description:
Returns the event delivery log.
Returns NOT_FOUND if the delivery ID doesn't exist.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is the unique identifier of the webhook event delivery.

parameters.name: webhookId
parameters.description: webhook_id filters deliveries by the webhook.

post.summary: ListWebhookDeliveries lists all event deliveries for a given webhook.
post.description:
Returns event deliveries matching the specified webhook ID.
Returns an empty list if no deliveries match the criteria.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

post.summary: CreateWebhook creates a new webhook configuration.
post.description:
Returns the created webhook configuration.
Returns ALREADY_EXISTS if a webhook with the same endpoint URL already exists.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

post.summary: RedeliverWebhookDelivery redelivers a specific webhook event delivery log.
post.description:
Useful for retrying deliveries after fixing endpoint issues.
Returns the redelivered event delivery log.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is the unique identifier of the webhook event delivery.

parameters.name: webhookId
parameters.description: webhook_id filters deliveries by the webhook.

get.summary: GetWebhook retrieves a webhook by its ID.
get.description:
Returns the webhook configuration.
Returns NOT_FOUND if the webhook ID doesn't exist.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is the unique identifier of the webhook.

delete.description:
Returns successfully if the deletion is completed.
Returns NOT_FOUND if the webhook ID doesn't exist.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is the unique identifier of the webhook.

put.summary: UpdateWebhook updates an existing webhook configuration.
put.description:
Returns the updated webhook configuration.
Returns NOT_FOUND if the webhook ID doesn't exist.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is the unique identifier of the webhook.

post.summary: TriggerTestWebhookDelivery manually triggers a test event delivery for a webhook.
post.description:
This is useful for verifying that the webhook endpoint is correctly configured
and can receive and process events.

Returns NOT_FOUND if the webhook ID doesn't exist.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is the unique identifier of the webhook to test.

post.summary: ListWebhooks lists all webhooks associated with an enterprise and client.
post.description:
Results are paginated and filtered by enterprise and client IDs.
Returns an empty list if no webhooks match the criteria.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

typeInterval.description:
Represents a time interval, encoded as a Timestamp start (inclusive) and a
Timestamp end (exclusive).

The start must be less than or equal to the end.
When the start equals the end, the interval is empty (matches no time).
When both start and end are unspecified, the interval matches any time.

v1EventType.description:
Type categorizes the event and determines how it should be processed.
Event types are grouped by functionality to maintain clear boundaries
and facilitate routing to appropriate handlers.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or invalid event type
Should not be used when creating new events
 - HEALTH_CHECK: Health check event for system monitoring
Used to verify webhook endpoint availability
 - APPOINTMENT_CREATED: New appointment has been created
Triggers notifications and resource allocation
 - APPOINTMENT_UPDATED: Existing appointment has been modified
Updates schedules and notifications
 - APPOINTMENT_FINISHED: Service delivery has been completed
Initiates payment and review processes
 - APPOINTMENT_CANCELED: Appointment has been canceled
Releases reserved resources
 - APPOINTMENT_DELETED: Appointment has been permanently removed
Cleans up associated records
 - APPOINTMENT_FULLY_PAID: All payments for the appointment received
Updates financial records
 - ONLINE_BOOKING_RECEIVED: New online booking request received
Initiates booking validation and processing

v1Organization.description:
Represents a MoeGo organization entity. Organizations are the top-level grouping
for resources and determine available features and capabilities.

v1OrganizationType.description:
- TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Reserved value. Do not use.
 - BUSINESS: Single-location business with standard features.
Suitable for individual pet service providers.
 - COMPANY: Multi-location business with advanced features.
Includes location management and roll-up reporting.
 - ENTERPRISE: Enterprise organization with full platform access.
Includes custom integrations and priority support.
v1OrganizationType.title:
Possible values are `business`, `company`, or `enterprise`.
The type determines available features and API capabilities:
* `business` - Basic features for single-location businesses
* `company` - Advanced features for multi-location businesses
* `enterprise` - Full platform access with custom integrations

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.
